title: Uniformly Positive Mean Dimension
summary: We study the relation between uniformly positive entropy and uniformly positive mean dimension at the level of fixed open covers. To a symbolic system X, we associate a hub-and-spoke system Spoke(X), obtained by replacing each symbol by a one-dimensional spoke attached to a common hub. We prove that if X admits a shift-invariant measure of full support, then Spoke(X) has completely positive mean dimension.
